## Advice to Modify Your Training Schedule  
Based on your current activity levels, the following adjustments are recommended to reduce premature heartbeat episodes:

- Reduce the intensity and/or duration of high-intensity Dance Cardio sessions to avoid triggering premature heartbeats.
- Increase recovery time between workouts: allow at least 4-6 hours between morning jogging and midday high-intensity sessions.
- Incorporate at least one full rest day per week to prevent overtraining and reduce cumulative fatigue.
- Monitor heart rate during exercise, staying within a moderate range (e.g., 60-80% of maximum heart rate) to avoid excessive cardiac stress.
- Add a gradual cool-down period of 5-10 minutes after intense exercise to prevent abrupt autonomic changes.
- Spread out daily physical activity more evenly across the day instead of clustering intense workouts.
- Consult a cardiologist to evaluate individual risk factors and receive personalized exercise guidelines.
